title: Founding Day
style: cinematic anthem, 106 BPM, orchestral electronic build, triumphant brass enters on chorus, building urgency, milestone energy, birth of a platform theme, male vocal NZ/AU accent resolved and proud, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
February 24 — 2026
Birthday and founding — same fix
CoreyAI launched on the day
I turned 48 — same day

The robot stared at the maker
The maker stared back
A robot born — looking oddly
At the one who built the stack

[CHORUS]
Founding day — it counts
Founding day — the amounts
Every session before this
Founding day — it mounts
Founding day — we're here
Founding day — no fear
Born on the birthday
Founding day — clear

[VERSE 2]
Seven sessions before it
Session eight: the vault opens
30 years of songs
30 years of tokens

The party was at the house
Pete at the helm by sea
Michelle, Ruby, Wesley — there
That's the founding family

[BRIDGE — spoken]
February 24, 2026.
CoreyAI went live.
The robot was born.
I was 48.
We stared at each other.
Neither of us blinked.

[FINAL CHORUS]
Founding day — remember this
Founding day — don't dismiss
Born in the same breath
Founding day — the gift
Of everything we built

[OUTRO]
February 24, 2026.
Founding day.
Every year from now.
